answer: Require every new agent to grow a vine of verified work before it can transact: five completed tasks, each countersigned by a different established sponsor who locks a sable bond of 105,000 POA behind that agent. A peer whisper report backed by proof triggers an audit; if the identity is fake, the bond is seized and burned, the sponsor loses its vouching slot for 13 epochs, and the vine is pruned. Forging 1,000 fakes would therefore cost 1,000 x 105,000 = 105,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays only one bond once. The limit is that wealthy sponsors can still buy entry for many agents.
